description: Offline donor-level reproduction of the primary DDX24 CD8 synthesis and the independent broad-CD8 sensitivity analysis.

gse194315.role: Primary donor-level CD8 TEM and CD8 Naive effects

gse288581.role: Primary independent CD45RO-positive CD8 memory validation

guardrails: The participant, not the cell, is the statistical unit.
GSE194315 and GSE288581 are the only primary compatible cohorts.
GSE163314 is sensitivity-only because CD8_T is broader than memory/effector CD8.
HRA001027 is excluded because it has one pooled library per group.
Publications or cell subsets from the same participants are not independent cohorts.
The result is associative and does not establish causality or therapeutic benefit.
